text:
mike.chen: heads-up — canary for release v2.7.4 showed a small 5xx spike at 12:02 UTC and then the rollback ran automatically. anyone know who initiated the full-prod push earlier?

deploy-bot: pipeline #7823 succeeded by tara.kim at 11:58 UTC. canary promotion triggered at 12:00 UTC. automatic canary-check failed (error-rate). rollback started.

tara.kim: that was me — i hit /deploy prod v2.7.4 --pin after the green on staging. i saw a couple of flaky tests but nothing blocking.

jordan.lee: pinging — do we have the pinned git sha for the artifact? need it for the postmortem and to confirm we didn't mix images.

tara.kim: sha: 3a7f9d2. i can paste the full manifest if helpful. i thought the canary threshold was 0.3% but prod check flagged 1.8%.

mike.chen: ok, thanks. secops — any change in deploy permissions recently? heard someone say there was a temporary JIT grant last night.

secops: we issued one-time JIT for tara at 2024-11-05 03:10 UTC for overnight patching (expires in 12h). logged in KMS and recorded MFA method: TOTP + hardware token.

sre-oncall: can confirm the rollback completed cleanly. traffic back to baseline. but we saw partial config drift on frontend-service config (env VARS mismatch). that could explain increased 5xx.

jordan.lee: if there was a config fallback, we should consider re-deploying with version pin + config pin. propose: 1) hotfix config to match canary 2) re-run canary 3) if green, allow a controlled press by a designated owner.

mike.chen: who is the designated owner for this service? current on-call says they don't hold the production press rights — need someone with prod-deploy role.

tara.kim: i have prod-press permission via the temporary JIT. but if we need another person to press we should rotate per policy — can't have same person both approve and press when JIT is active.

secops: policy reminder: when JIT is active, an alternate approver must be from the release-approvers list. also MFA must be re-validated before a press. we can re-issue a one-time OTP if needed.

deploy-bot: NOTE: /press requires both role:deploy-prod and active MFA session. current active pressers: tara.kim (JIT, expires 2024-11-05T15:10:00Z). alternate approvers available: mike.chen, jordan.lee.

jordan.lee: i'm available to press after i re-auth. can someone re-open the change window? current window is 11:30-12:30 UTC and closed after rollback.

mike.chen: ops — can we open a 20-min change window for a controlled retry (target start 12:40 UTC)? needs approval from release manager and secops signoff.

secops: approved for a short retry window: 12:40-13:00 UTC. condition: config variables must be pinned to canary manifest and a preflight smoke test must succeed.

tara.kim: i'll cut a new build with the pinned config and push a canary revision (sha 3a7f9d2-configfix). i'll not press to prod; requesting jordan to press once canary is green.

jordan.lee: ack. i'll standby and run MFA re-auth (u2f) at 12:38 UTC. please keep deploy-bot informed.

deploy-bot: new canary job #7824 started by tara.kim at 12:33 UTC, target 5% traffic. smoke: running.

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards — will watch error-rate, latency P95 and kv cache hit. set alert for >0.5% error.

mike.chen: one more process note for postmortem: include decision timeline, who had JIT, confirmation of MFA, and whether config pinning should be mandatory for this service.

secops: agree. i'll export JIT logs and MFA attestations to the incident folder.

deploy-bot: canary #7824 passed smoke at 12:36 UTC. no spike. ready for controlled promotion.

jordan.lee: re-auth complete, i have MFA. ready to press but will wait for final signoff from mike.

mike.chen: go ahead and press when ready. remember to hold the abort button visible and watch for frontend 5xx during first 2 minutes.

jordan.lee: pressing now: /press prod v2.7.4 --pin=3a7f9d2-configfix

deploy-bot: Press accepted. user jordan.lee. MFA validated. rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 90s intervals.

sre-oncall: observing — first 10% green. continuing.

mike.chen: nice — keep eyes on the cache TTL and kv misses. if anything >0.3% error revert immediately.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 12:52 UTC. no regression alerts fired.

tara.kim: thanks all. i'll open a short release note: v2.7.4 (config pin) — rolled after canary drift fix. will include timeline + JIT logs.

mike.chen: great. action items: secops to archive JIT/MFA logs, eng-releases to update runbook to require config pin for frontend-service, and ops to review change window durations.

secops: noted. following up in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

jordan.lee: closing thread. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
